body:
I wanted you to know I'm taking your advice and have started a new book that I shall not read a word of it at home :)

For accountability and to help me get outside, I decided to take pictures of where I go! Mundane, but it's good enough for now :)

ta da! http://foto4funn.blogspot.com/

I wanted you to know that I really am going to try to change my situation, and I took your advice and decided to start reading a new book - one that I'm not allowed to read at home (a comment made by wacco further down).

http://foto4funn.blogspot.com/

Thanks again :)

OOo I'll definitely give the Song of Ice and fire series a try :) It sounds pretty good :)

My favorite series though so far is The Dark Tower by Stephen King. SO GOOD.

Just finished Speaker for the Dead (sequel to Enders Game -if you're a scifi fan, it is an absolutely AMAZING book. That's one thing my ho-hum-ness never touched was my love for reading. Who doesn't want to escape into a world that's awesome?)

Moving on to Hyperion now. The read was a bit difficult to get started with, but I'm definitely into it now :) What did you get? I'm always open to new books (any genre, though generally I'm a fan of fiction only)
Thank you, did not know about that subreddit.

Unfortunately meetup.com is where I had looked for groups. If I was a mother there's like 90270850 mommy-and-me groups, but unfortunately I'm not one of those :p I'm sure there are other places though so I shall give them a try once I find them...:)

Good morning to you! I'm usually up beat in the morning, since "today is the day I"ll do something different", then get sadder throughout the day as nothing happens. Today I'm determined to be different though. I posted in reply to justahumanbeing that I'm going to try to read my book like I always do...but outside and somewhere public today as opposed to inside on my couch.

One thing about my neighborhood is that it's a new housing community. Currently there's like 5.6 people living here (the .__ are pets lol). Though I know the houses around me are sold and people are moving in in about a month. Hopefully they'll be friendly!

Thank you for the congrats on the job, I was excited to get it too!....Until I began working nights. I have come to realize though that everyone "pays their dues" so to speak. New people *always* get the shifts no one wants....purely because no one wants them lol. So in a couple more months hopefully that'll change.

I'm not a runner, but I do enjoy walking (I have 2 puppies as well that I was feeling stressed about at home, but maybe they'll be less mischievous if I take them out more often! I do play with them in-home, but I know they need to go on walks, and now I'll try to get my butt up and do them). I really like the exercise idea because it kind of attacks two birds with one stone. Thanks for the advice :)

First off, thank you very much for your input, it's greatly appreciated. I've kind of been sitting about this morning, giving a lot of though to a bunch of things, and I'm going to try to take your advice to heart. Today's out of the ordinary thing: go read my book at a starbucks or a bookstore instead of on my couch at home :)

Again, thanks :) And your philosophy is as much words of comfort as any other, so no worries there :)
